# Continental Tires

> > Comprehensive tire solutions and technical knowledge for car, motorcycle, and bicycle applications from Continental, covering seasonal tires, electric vehicle requirements, and advanced compounds like BlackChili and PureGrip.

Continental Tires provides detailed product information, tire knowledge resources, and maintenance guidance across automotive, motorcycle, and bicycle segments. The site features technical documentation on tire technologies, TPMS systems, and specialized products like the Grand Prix 5000 series for bicycles and VanContact range for motorhomes.

## Key Topics

- Continental Tires
- TPMS (Tire Pressure Monitoring System)
- BlackChili Compound
- PureGrip Compound
- All-season tires
- Winter tires
- Summer tires
- Electric vehicle tires
- Grand Prix 5000 series
- Cross King
- Motorcycle tires
- Motorhome and camper tires
- Tire maintenance and safety
- Seasonal tire selection
- SUV and 4x4 tires

## Tire Knowledge & Education

- [Tire Knowledge | Continental Tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/car/tire-knowledge): Main tire knowledge portal: basics, maintenance, TPMS, seasonal tires
- [Tire Knowledge | Continental Tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/car/tire-knowledge/tire-care-maintenance): Comprehensive tire care, maintenance, and TPMS knowledge portal
- [Tire Knowledge | Continental Tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/bicycle/tire-knowledge): Bicycle tire knowledge hub covering maintenance, safety, and TPMS basics
- [Electric vehicle tires – Everything you need to know | Continental tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/car/tire-knowledge/tire-basics/electric-vehicle-tires): EV tire requirements: rolling resistance, regenerative braking, wear
- [Tire types | Continental Tires | Continental Tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/car/tires/vehicle-types/all-vehicle-types): Complete tire types reference: seasonal, 4x4, summer, winter, all-season

## Product Catalog

- [Motorcycle tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/motorcycle): Motorcycle tire catalog: ContiSportAttack, TKC 80, ContiRoadAttack series
- [Cross King: First class all-rounder for competitions as well](https://www.continental-tires.com/bicycle/tires/mountainbike-tires/cross-king-racesport): Cross King mountain bike tire with PureGrip & BlackChili compounds
- [VanContact Camper: Mobile living enhanced by german technology | Continental Tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/car/tires/vancontact-camper): VanContact Camper motorhome tire with CP standard overload protection

## All-Season Tire Resources

- [Test results for all-season tires | Continental Tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/car/tire-knowledge/all-season-tires/all-season-tire-test-results): All-season tire test results, ratings, and performance reviews from Contidrom
- [All-season tires for RVs | Continental Tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/car/tire-knowledge/all-season-tires/all-season-tires-for-motorhomes): RV and motorhome all-season tire selection and maintenance guide

## Technology & Construction

- [Technologies Bicycle Tires | bicycle](https://www.continental-tires.com/bicycle/technology/city-trekking/safetyplus): Bicycle tire technologies: Black Chili, Vectran Breaker, tubeless-ready
- [Tire Construction - Motorcycle | Continental motorcycle tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/bicycle/service/faq/tyre-construction): FAQ on motorcycle tire construction types: crossply, radial, bias belted

## Manuals & Video Guides

- [Continental Bicycle Tires](https://www.continental-tires.com/bicycle/service/videocenter/manuals-road-bike): Road bike manuals featuring Grand Prix 5000 series video guides
